logline_en: He works far too hard to read a tiny phone mirror. She adjusts the full-size mirror above it.
logline_tc: 他費力盯著小小手機後視畫面，她只調好上方真正的鏡子。
staging_en: A parked left-hand-drive car, engine off. A fixed rear-bench camera looks forward, slightly from the driver side. Man in vehicle-left driver seat; heroine in vehicle-right passenger seat. Hips, knees and feet face the dashboard; seatbacks remain behind shoulders. The phone sits below-left of the real BLACK-framed mirror, taped crookedly near the windshield; leave a visible gap between the devices. Phone screen and selfie camera face the empty rear cabin, showing only two beige rear headrests, the rear-window frame and a quiet rear courtyard with a plain brick wall, low green plants and stone paving behind the car, with no people or interface. The real mirror initially points too high and reflects only beige headliner. Front windshield retains the approved river/city sunset; that forward view is different from the rear courtyard. Phone, tape, mount, seats and camera never move.

Add one original or appropriately licensed relaxed instrumental jazz bed around 80 BPM: soft piano, sparse upright bass and brushed drums, continuous through the bow. No vocals, humming, scat, speech, laugh track or comedy sting. Add clean synchronized object Foley separately, with no human voices; keep music below useful contact sounds. Do not add jazz or Foley instructions to the silent generation prompt. If your interface explicitly offers audio-off, use it; no such UI or API setting is assumed here. EPISODE FOLEY: Quiet parked-cabin ambience, robe rustle and one soft mirror-joint movement synchronized to the adjustment.
